artworks.title: Ornamental Design for Coffered Ceiling
artworks.description: The image displays a grid-like pattern made up of interlocking squares and rectangles with detailed linework. The arrangement features symmetrical floral motifs within each square, with central squares highlighting floral designs resembling blooming flowers or rosettes. The surrounding shapes include stylized vine or leaf patterns, all intricately connected.

artworks.title: Ornament with Sirens and Ornament with Genius
artworks.medium: etching (iron) with open bite or sulphur tint for tone
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.8 x 8.8 cm (5 13/16 x 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features two vertical panels filled with intricate and abstract linework and shapes. Flowing curves and intertwined forms create dynamic patterns that resemble mythical creatures and decorative motifs. On the left, abstract forms suggest the appearance of winged creatures with human-like figures enfolded within swirling leaves and waves. The shapes on the right take on the semblance of a cherub-like figure standing atop a grandiose bird-like creature, accompanied by flowing, serpentine lines resembling ocean waves. At the base, the lines converge into floral shapes reminiscent of a blooming arrangement. The composition emphasizes symmetry and balance, resembling ornate carvings or engravings associated with classical decorative arts.

artworks.title: Combat between Horsemen and Foot Soldiers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with heavily armored warriors and horses engaged in combat. The composition is filled with figures, primarily on horseback. The scene includes detailed depictions of horses in dynamic poses and warriors wielding weapons like spears and swords. Some figures are shown fallen in the foreground, while the background depicts rocky terrain and trees. Lines are used to convey movement and tension, showing the intensity and chaos of the conflict.

artworks.title: The Hay Harvest (June)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with farm laborers engaging in various tasks. The scene is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, with hills, small structures, and a building on a peak in the background. The artwork uses a detailed linework technique with fine brushstrokes, giving it a sketch-like appearance. It is rendered in monochromatic tones of beige and sepia, highlighting the intricate details. Figures in the foreground are interacting, some holding rakes and others seated with hats. The busy scene continues into the distance, where more figures work their way up the hills. The background includes more hills, clouds, and a partially concealed sun.

artworks.title: The Wine Harvest (September)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The scene depicts people engaged in wine or grape juice production in a hilly landscape. The background shows hills with detailed linework of trees and vegetation. The artwork is in a style resembling engraving or woodcut techniques with detailed textures and clothing. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of brown, likely due to a sepia effect. People are shown interacting with barrels and vats in intricate costumes. The landscape features hills and trees in the distance, blending activity with the tranquility of the countryside.

artworks.title: Madonna in the Clouds
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.4 x 10.8 cm (6 1/16 x 4 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper bodies of two figures, a woman and a child, positioned prominently at the center. The woman is seated, likely on a cloud, as the bottom of the frame suggests. She holds the child on her lap with both hands. Her head is slightly bowed and her eyes are softly closed. The woman has fine facial features and her hair is covered by a long veil or cloak. She wears a flowing robe that covers her from head to foot, leaving one foot partially visible. The child has curly hair and an endearing facial expression, looking away from the woman, with both arms outstretched. Surrounding them, the background consists of radiant lines suggesting divine light or holiness, and two faces of cherubs can be seen peeking from the upper corners.

artworks.title: On dit que les Parisiens...
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men seated closely together in an auditorium or theater setting. They are facing forward and applauding. Their facial features are exaggerated, with wide eyes and broad smiles. They have varying hairstyles, from balding to short cuts, and some display prominent wrinkles. They are dressed in suits or formal jackets with white shirts. Many are holding top hats in their laps. The background is filled with more audience members, drawn in a less detailed manner. The scene conveys a sense of lively engagement among the seated figures, with the front row more detailed than those behind.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques Avril I after Jean-Baptiste Pillement
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, asymmetrical cartouche design featuring floral and organic elements. The design includes swirling branches, leaves, foliage, flowing ribbons, and a basket at the center filled with plant life. The details are intricate, with patterns that emphasize elegance and delicacy typical of Rococo ornamentation. The use of lines and shading gives the drawing a sense of depth and texture, allowing the natural forms to stand out against the simplicity of the background.

artworks.title: Ornament with Parasol and Hanging Basket
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques Avril I after Jean-Baptiste Pillement
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design featuring elaborate foliage and a basket of flowers. The composition features swirling, leafy branches forming an elegant, oval-like frame on a plain background. The leaves are detailed with graceful curves and ferns. At the center-right, a basket is suspended, overflowing with flowers. The drawing demonstrates a refined level of intricacy and a mastery in the use of line and form for decorative effect.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Peacock
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques Avril I after Jean-Baptiste Pillement
artworks.description: The image showcases swirling intricate lines and ornate shapes that form an abstract pattern. At the center, there is a bird-like form reminiscent of a peacock with a long tail. Around it, the lines create a design resembling flowing foliage or feathery plumes. The overall composition evokes a sense of organic fluidity, with the shapes suggesting vines or branches in a stylized manner. The image has a baroque decorative design that merges abstract elements with naturalistic forms.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Monkey
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques Avril I after Jean-Baptiste Pillement
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring floral and animal motifs. The design includes a border made up of leaves, flowers, and vines. A monkey is seated on a branch and holding a stick. The leaves are detailed with fine lines and textures, creating depth. The monkey adds an element of curiosity and whimsy to the scene.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Strut and a Railing
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques Avril I after Jean-Baptiste Pillement
artworks.description: The image depicts an arrangement of curved and swirling lines, forming a pattern resembling ornate foliage. The abstract depiction intertwines nature-inspired elements, resembling vines or floral designs. The shapes connect to hanging garlands or ornamental wrought iron designs, blurring the lines between natural forms and stylized art.

artworks.title: Ornament with Flowers
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques Avril I after Jean-Baptiste Pillement
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate arrangement of floral and botanical elements forming an elaborate frame-like structure. The color palette consists mainly of shades of black and gray on a cream background. On the left, there is a cluster of large, blooming flowers set atop a curved stem, accompanied by several elongated leaves. To the right, a swirling, stylized vine or scroll decorated with intricate, smaller leaves and fronds completes the circular design, creating an elegant and symmetric composition.

artworks.title: Bolikana and Markolfus
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures, positioned side by side, with partly turned bodies as if in movement. The figure on the left has a rounded face, prominent lips, and a wide nose, adorned with a leafy crown in their hair. This person is dressed in a layered garment with a visible purse hanging from their waist and chains draped around their upper body. The figure on the right has a pudgy face, a prominent nose, and facial stubble, with a bird perched on their head, which sits atop a tangled nest of branches in their hair. This person wears a belted tunic with various circular decorations and long pants that tuck into their shoes. Both figures have expressive postures; the figure on the left leans forward, while the figure on the right has an upward gesture with their hand. The background shows a simple ground with sparse grass and a solitary flower sprouting from the earth. The image's upper portion has text with the names "BOLIKANA" and "MARKOLFVS" separated by initials "D H," and the artist's monogram "SF" is in the lower-right corner.

artworks.title: L'Amitié d'un grand chimiste...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. One person is seated, facing the viewer. Their features include a prominent forehead, eyeglasses, tightly pulled back hair, and they are holding a book or document. They are wearing a high-collared shirt and a jacket. The second person is standing, facing away from the viewer. Their attire includes a dark suit with a noticeable waist cinch, and they are holding a small dish or container. In the background, there are many faces gathered closely together. The setting appears to be a laboratory or lecture space, with a cluttered table of glassware, including a flask filled with liquid.

artworks.title: Ah!... les comètes...
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people watching a comet in the night sky in an urban setting. Buildings are in the background with dim street lights. A bright comet with a tail is in the sky. In the foreground, three figures are conversing. In the background, more people are observing the comet, with one person using a telescope. The scene conveys curiosity and awe, with a textured sky adding contrast to the comet.

artworks.title: Nouveau parapluie, par Brevet...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man trying to open an umbrella in the rain. The drawing shows a man in a suit, standing in the rain, attempting to open an umbrella that appears to be inverted or malfunctioning. The lines of rain are depicted heavily to show the downpour. The man's expression is one of surprise or frustration, and he holds a top hat in one hand while dealing with the umbrella in the other. The scene suggests a street, with part of a building and a sign visible in the background. The style is that of a caricature, emphasizing the comedic struggle and emotions of the situation.

artworks.title: Avoir perdu sa demi-tasse au Domino et sa bourse dans la rue
artworks.description: The image features a man standing to the left of a counter. He is wearing a tall, cylindrical hat, a dark coat with tails, dark trousers, and shoes. He is holding a wallet or case and looking intently at it with a serious expression. His facial features are drawn in a caricature style with a long nose and large eyes. To the right of the man, behind a counter, a woman is seated wearing a dress with puffed sleeves. She has neatly pulled back hair and a neutral expression. A large decorative bowl or basket sits on the counter between them. In the background, another man sits at a table, engaged in writing or playing a game, with a partial view of his companion who is turned away. The background is decorated with ornate patterns, suggesting an interior setting.

artworks.title: Origine des Bédoins a Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street encounter between two individuals. The scene shows a conversation or dispute on a cobblestone street. The focus is on the interaction, with expressive gestures from the figures suggesting dialogue. The main figure on the left is gesturing with their hands, while the figure on the right is leaning forward pulling a cart. The background includes sketchy figures and architectural elements in a bustling city street. The illustration features detailed linework and shading, creating texture and intensity.

artworks.title: Chiennes de bottes!...
artworks.description: The image depicts a man walking with his torso leaning forward and his feet stepping in an exaggerated manner. He has a hunched posture, clenched hands extended behind him, a long, pointed nose, a protruding chin, and an elongated face. He wears a tall black top hat, a long formal coat with coattails, dark trousers, polished shoes, and carries a walking stick. Surrounding him are people in 19th-century attire, including top hats and long dresses, appearing in motion. The background is a minimalistic open public space, possibly a street or square, with an indistinct crowd. The setting is monochromatic and sketched in a caricature art style.

artworks.title: Tu m'embêtes, mon épouse!... v'la une heure...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures walking through a snowstorm. The scene depicts snow flurries filling the air as the figures, dressed warmly, navigate the winter weather. Their expressions suggest discomfort as they move through the snow. The setting conveys movement and struggle, capturing the challenges of winter weather. The artwork has a monochromatic scheme with emphasis on texture to portray the snowy surroundings.

artworks.title: Un Complément de brillante éducation
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a room, both in clear view. The man on the left is in a kicking stance towards the man on the right, who leans back in response. Both men wear shirts with rolled-up sleeves. The man on the left has short cropped hair with a small ponytail, while the man on the right has thinning, short hair with a top knot. The man on the left wears a loose shirt and patterned shorts, while the man on the right wears a buttoned-up shirt and dark trousers. Both men have exaggerated facial expressions. The background includes hats and a coat on the wall, suggesting a simple interior setting, possibly depicting martial arts practice.

artworks.title: Mon cher! vous vous êtes admirablement... évanoui...
artworks.description: The image features two individuals shown from the waist up, engaged in conversation. Both are facing each other in a side profile view. The person on the left has a narrow face with pronounced cheekbones and a pointed nose, wearing a large, tall, brimmed hat with vertical ridges. The person on the right has a rounder face with a wide smile and is wearing spectacles perched on their lower nose, also donning a similar hat. Their hair appears to be curly and puffed out underneath the hat. Both individuals are dressed in long, dark robes with high collars over light-colored garments. The person on the right has their hand on their chest, while the person on the left extends a hand towards the other, touching their robe. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Vilain dormeur, va!
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of two individuals lying in bed. The person on the left is seated upright with their body turned to the right. They have delicate facial features and closed eyes. Their hair is covered and extends from under a cap or bonnet. They wear a loose garment, likely a nightgown. The person on the right is lying down, mostly covered by bed covers, with only their face visible. They have a broad face with pronounced eyebrows and a frown. They wear a nightcap with ruffled fabric. The setting appears to be domestic with ornate floral bedding. The background is softly shaded with no specific details.
